20031.factory_part_name: Arcooda Parts #17446 Arcooda 8 Player Deluxe Fish Cabinet
20031.long_desc:
The Arcooda 8 Player deluxe Fish Machine cabinet is a top of the range original product with guaranteed income and return investment for owners and operators. It is designed for gaming venues, can be transported in vertical mode, offers multiple internal wiring configurations and the widest options for player terminals, and payment options. Our sister company Highway Games was the first company to introduce the fish hunting series games to the USA Market with specially designed software and modular components. The Arcooda 8 Player Fish Machine cabinet is easily customizable;
  • Cabinet Artwork
  • Cabinet Colours
  • Cabinet Decorations & Acrylic Finish
  • Door Configuration
  • Payment: key in/out, coin hoppers, bill acceptors, card readers
  • Game Software
    • We have close relationships with hardware and software companies and can customize the fish machine to suit your venue. We also offer custom software options for a more profound impact on your market. MONITOR: 58 inch HD LCD Monitor SOUND: with 2.1 audio sound system, this custom sound package was designed for arcade, including subwoofer. Adjust the sound via volume control and separate subwoofer volume control. CONTROLS: The Arcooda 8 Player Deluxe Fish Machine illuminated joystick and buttons. Featuring large domed "SHOOT" and "ENHANCE" buttons on each control panel. CABINET: The cabinet has been specially designed to ensure the machine can be easily updated for future games and configurations. All Arcooda 8 Player Deluxe Fish Machines come with pre-cut panels for bill acceptors and thermal printers. This means operators can upgrade their machine with new parts without the need for extensive modification, wiring or technical expertise. LIGHTING: Multicoloured Light Up Attract modes PAYMENT SYSTEMS: The fish machine can be modified to suit a wide range of configuration options for both amusement and gaming venues. These configurations allow operators to choose the options that best suit their location for a more profound impact on their business. We offer key in / key out, coin in / hopper out, coin in / ticket out, bill acceptor / thermal printer, PlayPortal cashless card system and more. GAMEBOARD SUPPORT: Arcooda 8 Player Fish Machine can accept a wide range of fish hunting and video redemption-style game boards, supporting all IGS and non-IGS games such as Ocean King series, King of Treasures series, Seafood Paradise series, Santa Treasure, and Mystic Dragon. We also offer custom software options for operators looking for a specialised and distinctive product in their venue. UPGRADABLE: The Arcooda 8 Player Fish Machine is compatible with an extensive selection of video redemption games. The cabinet has been created to ensure it can be easily modified to suit new games. All internal components have a modular design and changing a game is as simple and disconnecting the old game and connecting the new game. Talk with our team on compatibility options.
